Cognition
Introducing Devin Desktop.

Manage fleets of local and cloud agents from one surface. Plan, delegate, review, and ship without leaving your editor.
介绍 Devin Desktop.

从一个界面管理本地和云代理集群。无需离开编辑器，即可规划、分配、审核和部署。

热门回复

@Cognition ♥ 51 · 💬 3

Devin Desktop supports the Agent Client Protocol (ACP): bring your own agents to work alongside Devin, all in one unified view.

@Cognition ♥ 50 · 💬 2

Devin Desktop is built on Windsurf, with all the features you know and love.

@Cognition ♥ 35 · 💬 2

Devin Desktop runs across your entire stack, with all the integrations, capabilities, and intelligence as Devin in the cloud. Plan locally and hand off to the cloud - Devin will continue to work after you close your laptop.

@Cognition ♥ 27 · 💬 0

Download Devin Desktop for free and try it today:

@Dev K ♥ 9 · 💬 0

Claude Code. Warp. Cursor. Devin Desktop.

every serious dev tool is becoming an agent orchestration layer.
the IDE was just the beginning.

my terminal is having an identity crisis just watching this.
